Test: country code mismatch

Source: R/test-docs.R
test_country_mismatch.Rd

Flags records whose coordinates fall outside the Natural Earth 1:50m country polygon named by their country code. The code is compared with the polygon's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, its alpha-3 code and the Natural Earth ADM0_A3 code, case-insensitively. Records without a code, and records at sea, are flagged.

Fields

lon, lat, country.

CoordinateCleaner

Equivalent to cc_coun(), which compares alpha-3 codes only; for alpha-3 codes present in Natural Earth the flags are identical. GBIF's countryCode is alpha-2 and works here without conversion.

See also

flag_occurrences(), flag_tests(), occ_columns()

Other tests: test_basis, test_capital, test_centroid, test_duplicate, test_equal, test_establishment, test_gbif_headquarters, test_gbif_issue, test_institution, test_invalid, test_sea, test_urban, test_zero

Examples

x <- data.frame(decimalLongitude = 16.37, decimalLatitude = 48.21,
                countryCode = c("AT", "AUT", "DE", NA))
flag_occurrences(x, tests = "country_mismatch")$flag_country_mismatch
